en: Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a resultant, a state that is a cause and a resultant arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under the root condition … pe … three under the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor a state with the nature of being a resultant, a state that is a cause and has the nature of being a resultant arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under the root condition … pe … three under the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on that which is neither-root, neither-resultant, nor of the nature to produce result, there arises that which is neither-root, neither-resultant, nor of the nature to produce result, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three for root; three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
